Author: Serpens66
Name: Troop Movement Fix 3
Description: Synchronizes mixed DefaultInSync groups at their slowest member's Vanilla maximum speed with a shared walk/run cadence, while Ctrl+move keeps Vanilla free-unit-speeds movement.

Changes: Use one shared running cadence bonus from the unit type that defines the group's slowest maximum speed.
Keep Archers synchronized with Assassins without accelerating the Assassins beyond their individual Vanilla maximum.
Use the smallest native bonus when multiple unit types share the limiting speed and remove the per-type bonus lookup from the cadence hot path.
Use each running unit type's native cadence bonus instead of assigning the Archer bonus to every synchronized runner.
Prevent Assassins and other lower-cadence runners from exceeding their individual Vanilla maximum speed in mixed groups.
Resolve and cache the small type-to-bonus table once per real movement order without adding a speed detour or recurring unit scan.
Synchronize every mixed DefaultInSync group at the slowest member's individual Vanilla maximum speed through the tribe MovementSpeed field.
Choose one shared running cadence only when every member type supports it; otherwise keep the complete group on a shared walking cadence.
Preserve Vanilla terrain and state penalties without a movement-speed detour, per-unit speed directives, timers, or recurring group scans.
Invalidate synchronization on Ctrl movement, target orders, selection-driven tribe assignment, later movement orders, and map unload.
Read Vanilla's Improved-Spearman option directly inside the native movement stub.
Keep Spearmen on their original walking-only path while the option is disabled.
Apply the Archer-equivalent walk/run decision only while Improved Spearmen are enabled.
Preserve the option's separate Vanilla combat behavior and the existing Ctrl freeUnitSpeeds path.
Move routine diagnostics from Info to Debug while keeping warnings and errors visible.
Remove logging and string creation for successful ordinary and Ctrl movement commands.
Replace the generic subscription collection with one direct process-lifetime movement subscription.
Remove unreachable plugin-shutdown cleanup and unused logging helper overloads.
Bypass only the official Improved-Spearman movement branch while preserving the option's separate Vanilla combat behavior.
Use the same native walk/run decision as Archers so Spearmen react consistently to synchronized movement and later selection or tribe changes.
Remove all persistent Spearman directives, group tracking, speed detours, cadence callbacks, animation corrections, and assignment handling.
Keep Ctrl movement on Vanilla freeUnitSpeeds without rewriting move types or per-unit speed values.
Bind Improved Spearman directives to the complete original movement group rather than only to the Spearmen.
Release all Spearman corrections when any original group member is reassigned, covering partial filtering of an Assassin or another non-Spearman.
Keep the release event-based without adding selection hooks, native tribe-rebuild hooks, snapshots, or persistent restoration.
Release the last synchronized Spearman delay, cadence, and animation in the post-assignment event so partial selection from an existing group immediately resumes running.
Preserve slower terrain and state penalties while removing only the previous group synchronization cap.
Keep the solution event-based without adding selection hooks, native tribe-rebuild hooks, snapshots, or persistent restoration.
Release an Improved Spearman correction when Vanilla reassigns that unit to a tribe outside a real movement order.
Let reassigned Spearmen resume the same Vanilla selection-driven movement changes as the other units without adding selection hooks, native tribe-rebuild hooks, snapshots, or restoration.
Keep ordinary movement commands and all selection/tribe rebuilding completely Vanilla.
Limit Improved Spearmen to the slowest normal maximum speed and matching cadence in mixed DefaultInSync groups.
Use Vanilla freeUnitSpeeds for Ctrl+move so every unit uses its own Vanilla maximum speed.
Deliberately accept Vanilla speed changes caused by later selection or tribe changes.
